import os, requests, urllib.parse, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
url=os.environ['GALAXY_URL'].rstrip('/')
with open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']) as f: key=f.read().strip()
tid='toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/bgruening/gfastats/gfastats/1.3.11+galaxy2'
xml=requests.get(url+'/api/tools/'+urllib.parse.quote(tid,safe='')+'/raw_tool_source', headers={'x-api-key':key}, timeout=30).text
root=ET.fromstring(xml)

def walk(e, path=''):
    name=e.attrib.get('name') or e.attrib.get('argument') or e.attrib.get('value') or e.tag
    p=f'{path}/{e.tag}:{name}'
    if e.tag in ('param','conditional','when'):
        attrs={k:v for k,v in e.attrib.items() if k in ('name','argument','type','value','label','optional','truevalue','falsevalue','checked','selected')}
        print(p, attrs)
    for c in e:
        if c.tag in ('param','conditional','when'):
            walk(c,p)
inputs=root.find('inputs')
walk(inputs,'inputs')
